name: 20 Pips Opposite Last N Hour Trend
summary: This EA trades against the prevailing trend of the last N hours, aiming for a 20-pip target. It identifies the directional bias over a configurable lookback period and enters a position in the opposite direction, expecting a mean-reversion move. The strategy uses fixed pip targets and stop losses for disciplined trade management.
summary_zh: 该EA逆最近N小时的趋势方向交易，目标获利20点。它通过可配置的回溯期识别当前趋势方向，然后反向开仓，预期价格会均值回归。策略使用固定的止盈和止损进行纪律化的交易管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是均值回归，即在识别出最近N小时的趋势后，反向开仓，赌价格会回调。入场条件是判断最近N小时的走势方向（通过价格变化或移动平均判断），然后在该趋势的反方向开仓。出场条件为固定的20点止盈和对应的止损水平。仓位管理采用固定手数，没有根据账户资金动态调整的机制。资金管理方面缺乏风险百分比控制，仅依赖固定手数和固定止损。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合震荡行情，但在强趋势市场中可能连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is mean reversion: after identifying the trend direction over the last N hours, it opens a position in the opposite direction, betting on a price pullback. Entry conditions involve determining the directional bias of the last N hours (likely via price change or moving average comparison), then entering a trade opposite to that bias. Exit conditions consist of a fixed 20-pip take profit and a corresponding stop loss level. Position sizing uses fixed lots without any dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management lacks risk-percentage controls, relying solely on fixed lot sizes and fixed stop losses. The overall strategy logic is simple and straightforward, suitable for ranging markets, but may suffer consecutive losses in strong trending conditions.

parameters.name: N_Hours
parameters.description: 回溯小时数，用于判断趋势方向

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识订单

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
有固定止盈止损，风险可控且纪律化
均值回归在震荡市中表现较好，能捕捉短期过度延伸后的回调
参数少，减少了过拟合的风险
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and verify
Fixed take profit and stop loss provide disciplined risk control
Mean reversion performs well in ranging markets, capturing pullbacks after short-term overextension
Few parameters reduce the risk of overfitting
cons: 在强趋势市场中会持续逆势交易，可能造成连续亏损
固定手数没有根据账户资金或波动率动态调整，资金管理不够灵活
没有趋势强度过滤，可能在不适合均值回归的行情中强行入场
固定20点止盈止损不考虑市场波动率变化，高波动时止损过近容易被扫
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Continuously trades against strong trends, which can lead to consecutive losses
Fixed lot sizing without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility lacks flexibility
No trend strength filter, may force entries in market conditions unsuitable for mean reversion
Fixed 20-pip TP/SL ignores market volatility changes; stops may be too tight during high volatility
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
improvements: 增加趋势强度过滤器（如ADX或ATR），只在趋势较弱或动能衰竭时入场
使用ATR动态调整止盈止损，适应不同波动率环境
增加资金管理模块，根据账户余额和风险比例动态计算仓位
improvements_en: Add a trend strength filter (e.g., ADX or ATR) to only enter when the trend is weak or momentum is fading
Use ATR-based dynamic take profit and stop loss to adapt to different volatility environments
Add a money management module that dynamically calculates position size based on account balance and risk percentage

risk_points: 逆势交易在强趋势中会连续亏损，缺乏趋势强度过滤
固定止损未考虑市场波动率，高波动期可能频繁被止损
没有新K线检查可能导致信号重复触发
risk_points_en: Counter-trend trading can result in consecutive losses during strong trends without a trend strength filter
Fixed stop loss ignores market volatility, potentially causing frequent stop-outs during high volatility periods
No new bar check may cause repeated signal triggers
